lines.text: Jesus appeared first to Mary Magdalene, who told the mourning disciples, but they did not believe her.
Jesus appeared in a different form to two walking in the country, and the rest did not believe them.
Jesus appeared to the Eleven as they were eating and rebuked them for their pride and hardness of heart.
Jesus told them to preach the gospel to every creature, and believers would drive out demons and pick up snakes.
Jesus was taken up into heaven and sat down beside Moses and Elijah, and the disciples preached everywhere.

wrong_details.true: at the right hand of God
